/**
 * @name Command Injection
 * @description Checking for command injection sinks in the package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-search
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command execution sink."
findings.hypothesis: Checking for use of subprocess or os.system which might indicate command injection risks if inputs are untrusted.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe XMLParser Configuration
 * @description Checks if XMLParser is instantiated with unsafe options allowing XXE or network access.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/lxml-unsafe-parser
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember("XMLParser").getACall() and
  (
    // Check if resolve_entities is True (explicitly)
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      arg = call.getArgByName("resolve_entities") and
      arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
    or
    // Check if no_network is False (explicitly)
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      arg = call.getArgByName("no_network") and
      arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = false
    )
    or
    // Check if load_dtd is True (explicitly)
     exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      arg = call.getArgByName("load_dtd") and
      arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
    or
    // Check if huge_tree is True (DoS risk)
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
      arg = call.getArgByName("huge_tree") and
      arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    )
  )
select call, "XMLParser instantiated with potentially unsafe configuration."
findings.hypothesis: XMLParser instantiated with unsafe flags (resolve_entities=True, no_network=False, load_dtd=True, huge_tree=True) exposing to XXE or DoS.

/**
 * @name Insecure SSL Configuration
 * @description checks for SSL contexts that disable verification
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-ssl
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Looking for ssl.create_default_context() modifications or ssl._create_unverified_context()
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall()
  )
  or
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    // verify_mode=ssl.CERT_NONE
    (
        call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("create_default_context").getACall()
    ) and
    arg = call.getArg(_) and
    exists(DataFlow::Node attr |
        attr = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("CERT_NONE").getAValueReachableFromSource() and
        arg.asCfgNode() = attr.asCfgNode()
    )
  )
select call, "Potential insecure SSL configuration."
findings.hypothesis: The package might configure SSL to ignore certificate errors, facilitating MITM attacks.
